title: Rodina Singh’s ‘Multwoh’ brings non-tragic queer ghost story to cinemas nationwide

blocks.text: Director Rodina Singh hopes to show that queer stories can be funny, romantic and entertaining as her film “Multwoh (Patay na Patay Sa’yo)” begins its nationwide theatrical release following its successful run at the 2026 CinePanalo Film Festival. “Queer stories don’t have to be tragic to be taken seriously. And they don’t have to be serious to matter,” Singh said in a statement sent to Inquirer Entertainment. The film follows Marcel (Sassa Gurl), a college student who returns as a ghost after dying before she could confess her feelings to her best friend, Miguel (Joao Constancia).
